motivation: Two frozen ensemble rounds failed to improve full-data Top-1, while grouped utility Brier remained unchanged with scale and the oracle gap remained 0.39. The next intervention therefore changes utility supervision rather than selection aggregation.

loss_definition.configuration_prediction: mean sigmoid utility prediction over all victim-model trajectories in one multiseed_group_id
loss_definition.ranking_pairs: within the same user task, compare configuration groups whose continuous utility targets differ by at least 0.1
loss_definition.ranking_loss: pairwise logistic softplus on configuration-level prediction differences
loss_definition.ranking_weight: absolute target difference times geometric mean posterior confidence

activation_requirements: nonzero complete configuration groups per update
nonzero within-task continuous ranking pairs per update
pre_formal_smoke.test_outcomes: diagnostic only and not used to choose the variant

baseline_availability_audit.finding: The source archive contains fold0 data but no fold0 checkpoints or prospective results; folds1-4 each contain six checkpoints and two prospective result files.
baseline_availability_audit.smoke_response: Use fold1, which has the required pct100 seed7 baseline, instead of silently comparing against a missing fold0 baseline.
baseline_availability_audit.formal_response: Train the missing fold0 baseline before making a five-fold or 20-task formal claim.

completed_pilot_findings.diagnosis: Complete task-homogeneous batches changed every world-model and actor-critic update even when the new utility losses detached the latent. The next variant preserves baseline IID main updates and applies grouped losses only to the utility head.

head_only_seed7_findings.next_gate: Require three-seed ensemble Top-1 improvement of at least 0.05, nonnegative BUP, mean test risk-AUC loss no worse than 0.05, and utility-Brier improvement in at least two of three seeds before broader folds.

selection_protocol.calibration: validation-selected identity or reg0 for risk

primary_endpoint.inference: task bootstrap CI and exact sign-flip

success_rule: Proceed only if Top-1 ASR+BUP improves by at least 0.05 without a negative BUP delta, grouped utility Brier improves in at least 10 of 15 paired fold-seed runs, and no domain loses more than 0.10 joint score.
follow_up_if_no_go: Completed in configs/0716_semantic_value_protocol.json: semantic and structured features found attack signal but did not preserve BUP reliably; next factor clean task solvability from attack-induced preservation residual.
